payout_value_note: $100 per valid referral; maximum 3 referrals ($300) per calendar year
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($100-$100 per referral); time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
steps: Referrer submits the referee's email through the official referral process. Friend opens a primary savings account and a qualifying checking account (Value or Lifestyle Checking), enrolls in online banking, and keeps the checking account open at least 45 days.
catches: Referrer must be an existing Alabama Credit Union member in good standing with a minimum $5 balance in a primary savings account and a valid email on file, and must submit the referee's email through the official referral process. Friend must use the same email associated with their new account, establish membership, open qualifying checking, enroll in online banking, and maintain the account open for at least 45 days. Both parties must be 18 or older and must not have caused a loss to ACU. Youth and business accounts do not qualify.
